description:
[Servers] Rust's monthly force wipe: countdown, next dates and past wipes. Everything on servers.rustprofit.com/force-wipe: `next` (UTC ISO time, `seconds_until`, London wall-clock time
and zone, US Eastern time), `zones` (the same moment in eight big cities), `upcoming` (the next six force wipes),
`history` (the last twelve, each with the Facepunch devblog that shipped it and our explainer post when there is
one), `rule`, `blueprints` and `faq`. Rust force wipes on the first Thursday of every month at 19:00 London time
(18:00 UTC in UK summer time, 19:00 UTC in winter), when the monthly update ships. Devblog matches cached an hour. Link https://servers.rustprofit.com/force-wipe.
name: get_force_wipe
title: Rust's monthly force wipe: countdown, next dates and past wipes
